question:
40. (i) If $k$ and $l$ are positive integers such that $k$ divides $l$, show that for every positive integer $m$, $1+(k+m)l$ and $1+ml$ are relatively prime.

(ii) Consider the smallest number in each of the $\binom{n}{r}$ subsets (of size $r$) of $S=\{1,2,\ldots,n\}$. Show that the arithmetic mean of the numbers so obtained is $\dfrac{n+1}{r+1}$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
